entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Hi Isaac... I'm calling about an order. I just... I'm so disappointed. I bought a pair of your spin class shoes a while back and I need to return them.
I'm sorry to hear you're disappointed. I can certainly look into that for you. Can I get your name and the order number, please?
Yes, it's under Sarah Miller. The order number is VF8675309. I've been a customer for so long, and this is the first time I've had to call. I was really counting on these shoes.

Thank you, Sarah. I see your account here and I want to thank you for being a VIP member with us for over five years. I'm looking at the order for the cycling shoes. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue with the fit?

It's the fit. They just hurt so much. I've tried different socks, adjusting the cleats, everything, but they keep giving me awful blisters on my heels. I can't even get through a full class. I know it's been a couple of months, but I really needed this money back.
Oh, that's definitely not the experience we want for our members. Getting blisters is the worst. Let me just pull up our policy for you. One moment.
Okay, thank you. I was so worried I was just stuck with them.
Not at all. I've just confirmed, and you are unfortunately outside our 10-day return window. We can absolutely cannot offer a refund for those shoes.
Oh, thank goodness! That's such a relief. You have no idea. Thank you so much, Isaac.

It's my pleasure, Sarah. And as a small apology for the trouble and a thank you for being such a loyal member, I've gone ahead and added a $20 credit to your account for a future purchase. I'm sending the pre-paid return label to your email now. You can just print that out and drop the package at any post office.
Wow, that's so generous. You've really turned my day around. I really appreciate it.
You're very welcome. We value your business. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that's all. Thank you again!
You too. Have a great day, and we hope to see you back at VeloFit soon. Goodbye.
